theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid N)) (y : Euclid N) (f : Euclid N → ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid N)) (L L' : ℝ), (∃ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ μ (closedBall y r₀) ≠ ∞) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ w, 0 ≤ f w) → (∀ w ∈ A, 1 ≤ f w) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L) → L < L' → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μ {z | r⁻¹ • (z - y) ∈ A} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L' * r ^ m)
